title: Unraveling the Phase Evolution of Conductive Filaments in Transition Metal Sulphides by In Situ Biasing TEM
content: The resistive switching behaviors are considered to be crucial for neuromorphic computing. Taking VO2 and Cu2S (two transition metal sulphides) as the model systems, using in situ biasing transmission electron microscopy (TEM), their phase evolution under electrical biasing has been systematically studied.
